fact: The Namibian reports that the National Artificial Intelligence Institute, launched in Windhoek on 23 September 2026 under NCRST, comprises a software development centre, datasets centre, AI innovation centre and R&D centre, and will develop and manage Namibian datasets.
The GSMA and the governments of Benin, Kenya, Namibia, Nigeria and Togo launched ATLAS Umoja AI to build AI models for African languages, with private partners Awarri, Zindi, Pawa AI and Mozisha.

New Era reports NCRST launched the National AI Institute in Windhoek, with research, software, datasets and AI innovation centres, and that it is working towards developing high-quality Namibian datasets.
The INCEIT page says C-DAC will set up a 5-node PARAM cluster (17.7 TF, including one NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU node) to be deployed at NUST, Windhoek, Namibia.
